items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: These guys you met, did Dan Carey read? ... No, Dan was an ear piano player.

ctx.x: How about -- didn't you run into the Lion about that time.

Oh, yeah, the Lion, the Lion used to -- they used to have a place on 129th Street and Tremont -- no, and what's that main street in New York. Seventh Avenue, used to call the Famous Door and every Monday night, it was piano night. Duke, Jimmie J.P. Johnson, Dan Carey, Joe Burrow, all them piano players, they'd come down and the Lion, the Lion would have his derby and a cigar and tap you on the shoulder, 'hey, I'll take it.'
Time for you to get up. What year was that.
